name: Atlassian Rovo
description: Atlassian Rovo provides AI-powered search and work across Jira, Confluence, Compass, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, Rovo, and the Teamwork Graph through Atlassian's hosted MCP server.
agentUseSummary: Connect a scoped Atlassian service account API key, then let agents discover and use the exact Rovo MCP tools granted by the organization under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions policy.

credentialRequirements.name: ATLASSIAN_ROVO_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Atlassian service account API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a scoped Atlassian service account API key after an organization admin enables API-token authentication for Rovo MCP.

capabilities.label: Tool discovery
capabilities.description: Discover tools granted by the Atlassian organization and service account.

capabilities.label: Read tools
capabilities.description: Call discovered Atlassian Rovo tools classified as read-only.

capabilities.label: Full MCP
capabilities.description: Call any provider-granted Atlassian Rovo tool under the selected Relay policy.

allowed.label: Discover tools
allowed.description: List bounded metadata for tools granted by Atlassian Rovo MCP.

allowed.label: Use a read tool
allowed.description: Call a discovered Atlassian Rovo tool classified as read-only.

approvalRequired.label: Use any granted tool
approvalRequired.description: Call any provider-granted Atlassian Rovo tool; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Discovery and read-only tools run directly; every other provider-granted tool requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected provider-granted tool runs without Relay per-action approval; Atlassian permissions, secret isolation, bounds, and audits still apply.

providerSetup.nextAction: An Atlassian organization admin enables API-token authentication for Rovo MCP, creates a least-privilege service account API key, and the customer enters it in Relay Console.

evidence.supports: Atlassian documents its hosted MCP at the fixed mcp.atlassian.com endpoint, with Jira, Confluence, Compass, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, Rovo, and Teamwork Graph tools governed by existing permissions.
Atlassian documents non-interactive service account API-key authentication with a Bearer header, subject to organization-admin enablement.
Atlassian documents product-dependent authentication, organization-controlled permission groups, and the current supported tool families.
Atlassian states that service-account and OAuth access honor configured scopes and the authenticated principal's existing product permissions.
